title: RTP, hit frequency and volatility
summary: Compute a game's true return, and see why simulations need millions of spins.

cards.title: Three numbers that define a slot
cards.body:
- **RTP** (Return To Player): the long-run average paid back per credit bet. 94.95% means 94.95 credits back per 100 bet, on average, over a very long time.
- **Hit frequency**: how often a spin pays anything.
- **Volatility**: how wildly results swing. Measured with the **standard deviation** of one spin's pay.

Two games can share an RTP and feel completely different: frequent small wins vs rare huge ones.

cards.title: Exact RTP by counting
cards.body: Every combination of stops is equally likely, so counting gives the exact answer, no randomness involved.
Brute force over 8,000 combinations takes microseconds. Big 5-reel games have billions of combinations, so studios count smarter (per-symbol products, like the table) or simulate.

cards.title: RTP by simulation
cards.body: Monte Carlo: play random spins and average. Watch how slowly the curve settles, and try other seeds in the Algorithm Lab.

cards.title: Why it takes so long
cards.body:
The error of an average shrinks like **σ / √N**. Lucky 3's σ is about 10 credits per spin, mostly because of the rare 800-credit jackpot.

To be 95% sure the RTP is within ±0.1 points you need (1.96 × 10 / 0.001)² ≈ **384 million** spins. 100× more spins only buys 10× more accuracy.

cards.question: 10 stops per reel, 3 reels, one 7 per reel. Only 777 pays: 500 credits for a 1-credit bet. What is the RTP?
cards.explain: 1 × 1 × 1 = 1 winning combination out of 10 × 10 × 10 = 1,000. Average pay = 500 / 1,000 = 0.5 credits per credit: 50%.

cards.question: Game A: RTP 95%, hit frequency 30%. Game B: RTP 95%, hit frequency 5%. Which is more volatile?
cards.explain: Same average return, but B pays far less often, so each win must be bigger on average. Bigger, rarer wins = higher variance. (Strictly you'd compare standard deviations, but that's the usual pattern.)

cards.title: Build it: an RTP calculator
cards.body: Compute RTP and hit frequency from per-reel symbol counts and a paytable. Your Lucky 3 answer must match this lesson's 94.95%.
